rungs.statement: Holm-Bonferroni over the 14 DECLARED demo rungs K1..K14

control_contrasts.statement: Holm-Bonferroni over the 4 DECLARED control-band contrasts (demo minus the mean of the three dose-matched non-demo draws), a SEPARATE family from the rung family above

shape.rule: f_K = |mean_delta_K| / max_j |mean_delta_j| over the declared family; rises over ADJACENT K only; STEP iff a single adjacent rise >= 0.50 of the full climb AND crosses 0.20 -> 0.50; RAMP iff monotone within 0.05 and no single adjacent rise > 0.40; else NEITHER

normaliser.why: normalising by a NAMED rung (the old ladder used K=8) puts the hypothesis in the denominator; the family maximum does not
